## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text by [地婆訶羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%B0%E5%A9%86%E8%A8%B6%E7%BE%85) Divākara treats the doctrine of *xiǎn shí* 顯識 ("manifesting consciousness") — the Yogācāra-Mahāyāna doctrine of consciousness-types and their relation to phenomenal manifestation. The work was incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* tradition.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [地婆訶羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%B0%E5%A9%86%E8%A8%B6%E7%BE%85) Divākara's Cháng'ān period (680 – 687 CE).

The Taishō text (T0347) is established on the standard apparatus.
